integration_notes: Apply existing_device_replacements by ID, preserving IDs for saved jobs. new_devices are app-ready catalog entries.
AOI additional split models intentionally have reverse:null outside204; UI must display unknown rather than null or zero.
BA referenceFrequencyMHz=1800 is literal manufacturer wording while band ends1794. Keep screening inconclusive; do not snap it to route frequency.
HGBT Spanish reference-output table is visibly misaligned/inconsistent with archived English version. This patch does not import those output values or use them as limits.
LGD 42/54 PDF has contradictory passband row52-1002/5-40 despite42/54title, so add verified65/86 variant instead.
For current GaN HGD, exact manufacturer PDF redirects homepage. Do not replace its link with different GaAs specs. Hide dead hyperlink, label archival reference and show unavailable exact PDF.
Optional GS7K nodes described separately in audit.md; iNode test-point coupling absent from its source, so null-safe UI needed before adding.
